question: shelah is recorded with more than one father: arpachshad, cainan.
note: Hebrew GEN 10:24 and GEN 11:12 explicitly state that Arpachshad begat Shelah; GEN 10:24 also supports Arpachshad as Eber's grandfather. LUK 3:35–36 places Cainan between Shelah and Arpachshad, so the rows accurately preserve differing genealogies.
